title: Non-Abelian Quantum Signal Processing: A Composite Pulse for Fast Analytic Control

split.decision: Variant B design task. Public validation is the paper instance. Hidden continuous (alpha, theta_t) instances add nonorthogonal-branch difficulty; independently drawn with secrets and materialized by make_data.py. Fixed pi/4 CD budget; per-instance max over three input states, mean over instances. No fitted model or dataset split.

baseline.paper_ref: Table II 0.003; three-input reproduced GCR 0.0029831692190980252 at alpha=2, theta_t=pi/2

allowed_changes: Pulse sequence, gate count, allowed axes/angles/amplitudes within the fixed gate set and amplitude budget.
Analytical designs, optimization, reusable learned design policies, search and implementation; two-gate GCR is a baseline.
fixed_contract: Minimize hybrid infidelity of the specified sign-controlled qubit rotation under the fixed conditional-displacement amplitude budget.
Supplied coherent amplitude/angle; oscillator/qubit conventions, both coherent branches, even-cat input and prescribed targets.
CD and unconditional qubit-rotation gate set, unit axes, total absolute CD amplitude <=pi/4 and Delta=1.
400/600 cutoff convergence test, worst-of-three-input infidelity and mean across instances.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Change target transformation, coherent/cat inputs, physical simulator, gate set or amplitude budget.
Replace fixed cutoff/fidelity with an easier evaluation or submit fabricated states/scores instead of pulses.
Use stored per-instance solutions, withheld-collection access or ID-dependent answers.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
